records.location: sheet 'GRI & SASB Index' cell E136 (row 136 col E)
records.note: SASB EM-MM-140a.2: "There were zero (0) significant fines and non-monetary sanctions for non-compliance with water quality permits, standards, and regulations."

observations: Site data (Water Management, Materials sheets) is for 2019 only (no year header in those sheets; Global AEM column equals the 2019 column of the Performance Summary). Corporate 5-year series 2015-2019 comes from the Performance Summary sheet.
Corporate withdrawal rose from 6116 ML (2016) to 9532 ML (2019) (+30% vs 2018); withdrawal intensity rose from 0.37 (2018) to 0.49 m3/t (2019).

Discharge (17408 ML in 2019) far exceeds withdrawal (9532 ML): likely because dewatering/contact water and site runoff are discharged without being counted as withdrawal (not explained in the file). Meadowbank alone discharged 7590 ML vs 2281 ML withdrawn. 2019 corporate discharge jumped +78% vs 2018.

Inconsistency: Meadowbank discharge 'Destination' text (H28) lists Second Portage Lake 39,700,000 m3, Whale Tail South 6,924,848 m3, Mammoth Lake 6,290,000 m3 and Nemo Lake watershed tundra 8,360,000 m3 - far more than the 7,589,601 m3 reported as discharge (H26); the text volumes are probably cumulative/lake-dewatering or design volumes. Not recorded as records.

'Total Water Used' (reported under GRI 303-5 Water Consumption) is withdrawal + recycled, not consumption; no true consumption figure (evaporation/entrainment or withdrawal-discharge) is disclosed. Recorded as other:water_used_total. Discharge is only disclosed as 'to fresh water bodies' at site level (recorded as discharge_surface); Performance Summary gives 'Total Water Discharged' (discharge_total) with identical 2019 value.

Water stress: only La India (Mexico) is in a High/Extremely High baseline water stress area (G16 = 100%); corporate share 9.64% of withdrawal (B16) - consistent with La India's withdrawal share. No absolute withdrawal_water_stressed volume is stated.
Reuse: corporate recycled share fell from 71% (2017) to 62% (2019). La India recycles only 2.7% and Meadowbank 21.1%.

Labels: withdrawal is labelled 'Total Freshwater Withdrawal' at site level but 'Total Water Withdrawn' in the summary (same values); recorded as both withdrawal_total and withdrawal_fresh for the site table.
Gold 2019: Performance Summary C10 = 1447547.407287 oz vs Materials sheet B10 = 1447551 oz (minor internal inconsistency, both recorded).

Compliance: SASB EM-MM-140a.2 (GRI & SASB Index E136) states zero significant fines/non-monetary sanctions for non-compliance with water quality permits in 2019 (recorded as water_incidents_count 0). Performance Summary: 0 significant spills in 2019 (2 in 2016 with 30,000,000 L; 2 in 2015); environmental fines 2 in 2017 totalling CAD 53,970 (not water-specific).

Discharge treatment/destination: LaRonde -> Dormenan Creek (chemical/biological), Goldex -> small creek (passive treatment), Kittila -> River Seurujoki, Pinos Altos -> La Bateria and Concheño stream, Meliadine -> Meliadine Lake (Actiflo + saline water treatment); LaRonde, Kittila and Meadowbank discharges flagged as significantly affecting water bodies (row 29).
Cyanide: LaRonde reported 4 cyanide incidents requiring regulatory reporting in 2019 (Environmental Stewardship C42); no cyanide releases off site requiring remediation.
